atoms.name: LLM Inference Capability
atoms.description: Capability to invoke a large language model for text generation. Required by all inference plugins.

atoms.name: Read Filesystem
atoms.description: Read files from the filesystem without write access. Required by any plugin that loads config or data files.

atoms.name: Inference Plugin v1 Interface Contract
atoms.description: Standard interface contract for LLM inference plugins in the Olympus runtime. Required methods: invoke, stream, count_tokens, supports_tools.

atoms.name: On Session Start
atoms.description: Fires when a new session or conversation begins. Plugins use this to load state, verify credentials, or inject context.

atoms.name: GitHub Read
atoms.description: Read-only access to GitHub repositories, issues, and PRs via the GitHub REST API
